annotations.title: Get the state of a job

description:
Get the state of a job: status, estimate, approval, settlement, and error.
Poll every 5 to 10 minutes until the status is COMPLETED, FAILED, or CANCELLED.
The time depends on the number of products, because DeepScout fetches the pages at
a rate that the e-shop accepts. The usual times, with the wait in the queue, are:
- setup: from a few minutes to 3 hours.
- scraping: 1 to 2 hours for a few thousand products, several hours for 20,000, and
  up to 1 day for 100,000 or more.
- matching: 1 hour for 1,000 products, 4 to 15 hours for 10,000, 1 to 2 days for 50,000.
- EXPORTING, the last status: up to 1 hour.
scrape_progress.percent and matching_progress.percent show the progress.
matching_progress.estimated_minutes_left shows the time left. In the queue and in
some phases, the progress does not change. A job without an error is not stuck:
tell the user about a problem only if the job FAILED.
